captions.detailed: A Maksutov-Cassegrain telescope mounted on a computerized equatorial fork mount and supported by a steel tripod. The telescope itself is a compact, dark blue cylindrical optical tube with a light grey front aperture ring and a black rear cell with a small eyepiece adapter. It is secured within a black, single-arm fork mount that sits atop a computerized equatorial drive base. The entire assembly is supported by a three-legged light grey tripod with black accents on the central spreader and rubber feet.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a Maksutov-Cassegrain telescope on an equatorial fork mount and tripod. The telescope should feature a dark blue cylindrical tube with a light grey front ring, a black rear cell, and a black mounting bracket. The mount should consist of a black fork arm connected to a dual-axis equatorial drive head, which sits on a three-legged silver tripod with a black central spreader ring.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by defining parts hierarchically. First, the tripod base is built using cylindrical legs and a central hub with a spreader ring. Next, the equatorial mount head is created using a series of rotated cylinders and boxes to form the polar axis drive and declination housing. The fork arm is constructed using combined box primitives. Finally, the optical tube assembly is modeled as a primary blue cylinder, a light grey front cylinder ring, and a black rear cylinder with an eyepiece adapter, all positioned on the declination axis.
